subject: ArmPkg/ArmStandaloneMmCoreEntryPoint: Ensure section length alignment
reasons: Neighboring commit a631987420 (StandaloneMmPkg) applies the exact same pattern: replacing raw SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize with ALIGN_VALUE(SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize, SectionAlignment) in permission updater calls
Same author, same commit message, same fix applied to a different package - clear collateral evolution series
Structural, well-defined before/after pattern that Coccinelle can express as a match on function calls using VirtualSize and replace with the aligned version
candidate_pattern: Replace permission updater calls using raw VirtualSize with ALIGN_VALUE(SectionHeader.Misc.VirtualSize, SectionAlignment) where SectionAlignment is the ImageContext->SectionAlignment
